_comment: This is a vendored/offline WebFlash alignment-test fixture, not the authoritative upstream catalog.
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sense360store/esphome-public/main/config/product-catalog.json
Used by __tests__/product-catalog-alignment.test.js (WF-PRODUCT-001 / -002 / -003).
CI defaults to this fixture so tests run offline. To validate WebFlash
against a freshly downloaded upstream catalog, set the PRODUCT_CATALOG_PATH
environment variable to the absolute path of the downloaded JSON, e.g.:
PRODUCT_CATALOG_PATH=/tmp/product-catalog.json npm test -- product-catalog-alignment
Refresh this fixture manually when the upstream catalog promotes a new
config to production/preview that WebFlash needs to import or ship, or
when a status WebFlash relies on changes (e.g. FanTRIAC becoming
production-eligible).
This fixture is intentionally minimal: it contains only the entries
needed to exercise the validator's eligibility branches (production,
preview, blocked, legacy-compatible). It is not a full mirror of the
upstream catalog and must not be treated as authoritative.
WF-PRODUCT-003 refresh checkpoint: upstream catalog snapshot at refresh
time held 34 products = 1 production (Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ),
1 preview (Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ-LED, added by upstream PRODUCT-009),
1 blocked (Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-FanTRIAC-RoomIQ), and 31 legacy-compatible
entries enumerated by upstream PRODUCT-002. The WF-PRODUCT-002 fixture's
synthetic Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ-Preview placeholder was removed and
replaced with the real upstream LED preview entry — the fixture now
carries only real upstream rows plus one representative legacy-compatible.
The LED preview exists upstream only: WebFlash has not imported, signed,
manifested, or surfaced it. Release-One remains Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ
(LED-less). FanTRIAC remains blocked.
WF-PREVIEW-IMPORT-FIRST-BATCH-001 refresh checkpoint: upstream published
the v1.0.0-preview release with four build-proofed preview binaries. The
current upstream catalog snapshot holds 42 products (1 production, 4
preview, 1 blocked, 3 hardware-pending, 2 compile-only, 7 legacy-compatible,
24 removed). WebFlash imported THREE of the four new preview binaries —
Ceiling-POE-AirIQ-RoomIQ, Ceiling-POE-RoomIQ, Ceiling-POE-RoomIQ-LED — as
preview-channel builds. The fourth (Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ-LED) was
already imported from v1.0.0-led-preview and is unchanged. This fixture now
carries all four real upstream preview rows plus Release-One (production),
FanTRIAC (blocked), and one representative legacy-compatible entry. Active
WebFlash surfaces: firmware/sources.json + manifest.json + firmware-*.json
now resolve to Release-One (stable) + four preview builds + the WebFlash-owned
Rescue build. The production-only allowlists are UNCHANGED — REQUIRED_CONFIGS
stays [Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ, Rescue] and scripts/data/kits.json stays
Release-One-only. Preview builds are acknowledgement-gated, never stable,
never recommended, never a customer default, and never publicly buyable.
description: Product source-of-truth catalog fixture for WebFlash alignment tests. Refreshed under WF-PRODUCT-003 against the current upstream esphome-public product catalog (now exposing the LED preview sibling).

products.notes: Release-One production target. FanTRIAC blocked per HW-005; LED excluded because config string carries no LED token. See docs/release-one.md and docs/release-one-hardware-audit.md.

Real upstream LED-bearing sibling product, promoted to a preview build by upstream PRODUCT-009. PRODUCT-006 added the canonical YAML; PRODUCT-008 added the WebFlash wrapper at products/webflash/ceiling-poe-ventiq-roomiq-led.yaml and promoted the catalog entry from compile-only to preview with webflash_build_matrix=false; PRODUCT-009 flipped webflash_build_matrix to true, declared version=1.0.0 / channel=preview / artifact_name=Sense360-Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ-LED-v1.0.0-preview.bin, and added the matching entry to upstream config/webflash-builds.json on the preview (non-stable) channel. No firmware artifact is built or imported by PRODUCT-009; that build / release proof remains outstanding upstream. WF-PRODUCT-003 mirrors this entry into the WebFlash alignment fixture so the preview-eligibility branch is exercised against real upstream data, but WebFlash itself has NOT imported, signed, manifested, or surfaced this preview: firmware/sources.json, manifest.json, firmware-*.json, REQUIRED_CONFIGS, and scripts/data/kits.json still resolve only to Release-One (Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ) and the WebFlash-owned Rescue build. Release-One stays Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-RoomIQ on stable (LED-less); FanTRIAC stays blocked under HW-005 and is carried in this entry's blocked_modules. Hardware evidence upstream: S360-300 schematic_status=verified (HW-008); ceiling LED package binds led_data_pin=GPIO38 (HW-010); LED_DATA / Sense360 LED firmware-package mapping is confirmed-ok after HW-010 (HW-009). Bench-verification open questions in upstream docs/hardware/s360-300-r4-led.md (harness rail, LED count, harness identity) remain carried as preview-stage caveats and must resolve before any production promotion. See upstream docs/product-led-preview-decision.md.
